name: Ring of Deafening Roar
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of the lion and functions as such. Whenever the shout ability is used, however, the wearer must succeed a DC 20 Fortitude save or be struck deaf as per the blindness/deafness spell.

The ring can be removed freely. The deafness remains until magically cured. If the wearer does not also have remove curse cast upon him after the deafness is cured, the deafness returns in 1d4 days.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of the lion

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
